accel_query_sql: SELECT vendor_id,sum(passenger_count) AS passengers,avg(passenger_count) AS mean_passengers,count(*) FILTER (WHERE passenger_count IS NULL) AS missing_passengers,count(*) AS n FROM bench_nyc_taxi WHERE (passenger_count IS NULL OR passenger_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4) GROUP BY vendor_id
